name: chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot
description: Generic autopilot for auditing, building, repairing, validating, packaging, and submission-preflighting ChatGPT/Codex plugins

interface.longDescription: Audits arbitrary repositories, builds or repairs ChatGPT/Codex plugin configuration, catches package and directory validation failures, produces deterministic installable ZIPs, and keeps local artifact proof separate from public submission status.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and make its ChatGPT/Codex plugin production-ready.
Validate and package this repository as an installable ChatGPT/Codex plugin.
Diagnose this plugin submission failure and repair the root cause.
